data.title: Upper House
data.about:
Upperhouse by Ellington is a bright new development in one of the most vibrant towns. Upperhouse will meet your demand for greater design, sociability, and well-being. This gorgeous property is located in the heart of a recently refurbished and ever-expanding location, and it also acts as a concrete representation of a rising neighborhood. 

Choose from a variety of studios and 1 to 3 bedroom apartments where natural features coexist with modern lifestyles. These holistically designed apartments are located in the heart of Jumeirah Lakes Towers. This is a property that broadens perspectives by giving easy access to a wealth of services as well as expansive views of the Jumeirah Islands and Marina Skyline.

location_tile.title: Situated in Dubai's most exclusive location
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Upper House in Jumeirah Lakes Towers is located across Dubai Marina and has turned into a fantastic residential community if you want to live in an area surrounded by a panoramic waterfront promenade and breathtaking surroundings. Jumeirah Lakes Towers also has a variety of retail and office space, as well as a lot of dining and shopping options, amusement and entertainment opportunities.

  • 02 Mins from Jumeirah Lakes Park
  • 02 Mins from DMCC metro station
  • 13 Mins from Mall of the Emirates
  • 15 Mins from Palm Jumeirah
